title: Find which font an alias points to
summary: Determine the actual font file used for generic aliases like 'monospace', 'serif', or 'sans-serif'.

steps.explain: Use fc-match to query the font associated with a specific alias.

placeholders.name: ALIAS
placeholders.description: The font alias to check (e.g., monospace, serif, sans-serif)

verify.expect: Output shows the font file and family name, e.g., DejaVuSansMono.ttf: "DejaVu Sans Mono" "Book".
